To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IL-6 induces expression of the hAG gene through the recruitment of HNF-1α and STAT-3 to the promoter region of the gene.
IL-6 induced expression of the human hAGT gene is regulated by three transcription factors HNF-1a, GR, and STAT-3 that bind to three different regions of the hAGTG gene promoter.
IL-6 induces hAGT gene expression by activating the APRE-1, APRE-2 and APRE-3 regions of the hAGTG gene promoter through the recruitment of STAT-3 to these regions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanism of the transcriptional regulation of the human angitensinogen gene by IL-6 and other cytokines.
the molecular mechanisms that regulate the expression of a gene that is associated with human hypertension.
the identification of the molecular mechanisms that regulate hAGT gene expression in response to IL-6 and other stimuli.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IL-6-induced AGT promoter activity is regulated by a complex interaction between HNF-1 alpha, STAT-3 and GR.
IL-6-induced hAGT expression is mediated through the interaction of GR and HNF-4alpha with APREs and the interaction of HNF-1 with APRE-2.
IL-6-induced AGT expression involves a complex interplay of transcription factors that include STAT-3, GR, and HNF1-alpha.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IL-6 induces the expression of the hAGGT gene by recruiting STAT-3 to the APRE-1 and APRE-3 sites, which in turn recruits HNF-1a to the APRE2 site.
IL-6-induced AGT expression in liver is mediated by STAT-3 binding to APRE-1 and APRE-3, HNF-1 alpha to APRE-2 and GR to proximal promoter region.
IL-6 induces AGT gene expression via a mechanism that requires the interaction of multiple transcription factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IL-6-induced AGT gene expression may be mediated by the interaction of HNF-1α and STAT-3 with GR.
the proximal promoter region of this gene is an IL-6 responsive element and this region contains binding sites for HNF-1α, STAT3 and GR.
the proximal promoter region of the hAgt gene is a hot spot for transcription factors that are responsible for its regulation.
